papers.title: Fairness and incentives in combinatorial assignment
papers.title_ja: 組み合わせ割り当てにおける公平性とインセンティブ
summary_ja: リソース制約下の不可分財割り当てに公共財的アプローチを導入する。
リンダール均衡として支持される羨望フリーかつ効率的な割り当てを示す。
経済規模の拡大に伴い羨望と操作による得が消失する耐戦略性を証明する。
papers.reason_ja: 不可分財の公平分配と耐戦略性の近似成立を論じているため。
papers.abstract: We consider the fair and efficient random assignment of indivisible goods subject to resource constraints. Agents receive bundles randomly, but individual lotteries over bundles that are feasible in expectation need not be jointly feasible. Consequently, we treat a lottery over feasible allocations as a public good. We show that every feasible finite economy admits an envy-free and Pareto efficient random assignment that may be supported as a Lindahl equilibrium. For a finite type space with specified expected utilities, we construct a mechanism whose outcomes are exactly feasible and Pareto efficient with respect to reported preferences. As the population grows and empirical type proportions and per-capita resources approach a limiting large economy, envy and gains from manipulation vanish. The approximate incentive compatibility of the mechanism holds for all type profiles that approximate the limiting economy. The argument combines sensitivity bounds for linear programs with proximity bounds between fractional and integer optima.

papers.title: The Entangled Veil: Why Redistribution Requires a New Language
papers.title_ja: もつれた無知のヴェール：なぜ再分配には新しい言語が必要なのか
summary_ja: ロールズの無知のヴェールを従来モデルで表現する限界を指摘する。
世代間対称性と位置間相関を捉えるため弦理論に応用された幾何学枠組みを提示。
量子もつれ概念を用いて新たな再分配政策の評価モデルを構築する。
papers.reason_ja: 無知のヴェールと正義論を物理学的な新モデルで再解釈しているため。
papers.abstract: The Rawlsian veil of ignorance requires choosing principles of justice without knowing which position-temporal, spatial, social, or personal one will occupy. We argue that this object cannot be represented faithfully within standard economic models. A faithful representation must satisfy three requirements: it must treat all generations symmetrically, capture non-separable correlations among positions, and allow mobility costs to vary across locations and occupations. We show that standard optimal-tax models violate at least one requirement, and that the minimal framework satisfying all three is a geometric framework adapted from string theory, in which the veil is an entangled state over a space of possible life situations. We derive full equalization as a first-best benchmark, the emergence of separated clusters when correlations reward distinction, a symmetry between intraand inter-generational equity, and a tunneling mechanism by which correlations reduce institutional barriers. The model generates four inequality profiles and four inequality types. The estimates are quantitatively important: the framework changes the ranking of redistributive policies, and ignoring the margins it identifies leads to systematically biased policy evaluation.

papers.title: A Deterministic Polynomial-Query Protocol for Envy-Free Cake Cutting
papers.title_ja: 羨望フリーケーキ切り分け問題における決定性多項式クエリプロトコル
summary_ja: n人の羨望フリーなケーキ分割を多項式クエリで達成する決定性手法を提案。
認証付きトリミングを活用し羨望のないサフィックス割り当てを効率化する。
完全羨望フリーな家事割り当て問題に対しても同様の計算界を導出する。
papers.reason_ja: 公平分配（フェアディビジョン）の計算複雑性における大きな進展だから。
papers.abstract: We give a deterministic protocol that divides a heterogeneous cake completely and without envy among $n$ agents using $O(n^6\log n)$ Robertson--Webb queries in the worst case. Valuations may be arbitrary nonnegative, nonatomic measures, and bundles may be disconnected. The protocol makes $O(n)$ calls to certified trimming, which uses $O(n^5\log n)$ queries on $n$ pieces. In a certified trim, each agent receives the end part, or suffix, of a different piece without envy, and every shortened piece has a witness tie leading back to a whole piece. At each step, the witness values the shortened suffix exactly as much as her own. For pieces of positive interval length with strictly increasing suffix values, the retained suffix lengths are unique, although their holders may differ. Candidate assignments share a table of value and cut queries. If the coordinatewise median of their value estimates fails a matching test, the test identifies an agent whose value is underestimated, ruling out at least half the remaining assignments. A weighted median of cut marks lets one repair step remove a small envy while allocating almost all of the residue. For complete envy-free chore allocation, the query bound is $O(n^7\log n)$.

papers.title: Anonymous and Strategy-Proof Social Choice under Uncertainty
papers.title_ja: 不確実性下における匿名かつ耐戦略的な社会選択
summary_ja: 要旨がないため推測だが不確実性下での社会選択ルールを考察しているとみられる。
構成員を平等に扱う匿名性（anonymity）の条件を分析していると推測される。
虚偽の表明を防ぐ耐戦略性（strategy-proofness）の成立可能性を探る内容と思われる。
papers.reason_ja: 社会選択理論の根幹である匿名性と耐戦略性を扱っていると推測されるため。

papers.title: Large Economies with Social Types
papers.title_ja: 社会的タイプを伴う大規模経済
summary_ja: 個体名と参照グループを示す社会的タイプを持つ大規模経済モデルを構築。
競争均衡が存在するための必要十分条件として「社会的匿名性」を導出。
選好の非凸性や不可分財に対応しピア効果やリスク共有へ応用する。
papers.reason_ja: 匿名性概念と外部性を組み込んだ一般均衡理論を展開しているため。
papers.abstract: This paper develops a new general equilibrium framework for large economies with social externalities, where agents have names as well as social types. Social types define the reference groups (neighborhoods, peers, or status classes) through which externalities operate, and are primitives of the market structure. We establish that every admissible economy admits a competitive equilibrium if and only if social anonymity holds. This condition requires that observable social types do not fully identify individuals within any non-negligible subeconomy. The framework extends to generalized large economies with incomplete preferences, indivisible goods, and production, and thus accommodates nonconvexity in preferences and consumption sets. Our proof replaces the standard aggregate convexification argument with conditional convexification. Applications include peer effects, social comparison, and risk sharing with local social benchmarks.

papers.title: Principal Revelations of the Revelation Principle
papers.title_ja: 顕示原理に対する主体の開示
summary_ja: 顕示原理の逆を証明し、本原理が最善の均衡プレイを前提とすることを主張。
事前分布が曖昧な場合、プリンシパルに好都合な分布の仮定が必要と示す。
準線形環境では直接メカニズムによる近似が達成可能であることを論じる。
papers.reason_ja: メカニズムデザインの基礎である顕示原理の仮定と限界を再検証するため。
papers.abstract: I prove a converse to the revelation principle, arguing that it is a principle of optimism: if it must hold for all environments (in fact, even just those with private values and independent types) the principal must assume her favorite equilibrium is played by the agents. When the principal knows only that the prior lies in some set, she must additionally assume it is her favorite one. With private values, independent types, and quasilinear payoffs, however, unrestricted transfers allow the principal to approximate any mechanism's equilibrium payoff via a direct mechanism whose unique equilibrium is truthful.

papers.title: Stay or Switch? Metric Distortion with Online Candidate Arrivals
papers.title_ja: 維持か変更か？候補者がオンライン到着する場合の距離歪み
summary_ja: 候補者が順次到着するオンライン投票における距離歪みを分析する。
決定性ルールでは現職優先閾値ルールにより最適界が得られると示す。
確率的ルールではランダム独裁制により歪みを定数に抑えられると実証する。
papers.reason_ja: 歪み（distortion）理論を動的な候補者到着モデルに拡張しているため。
papers.abstract: We study metric distortion in sequential elections with online candidate arrivals. In each round, a newly arriving challenger competes against the incumbent, and a voting rule must select one of the two based on voters' pairwise preferences. Our goal is to guarantee low metric distortion at every round, relative to the best candidate among all those that have arrived so far. For deterministic rules, we establish an asymptotically optimal bound of $Θ(\sqrt{t})$ at round $t$, achieved by a threshold rule favoring the incumbent. In contrast, randomization allows constant distortion. We show that persistent randomized dictatorship achieves optimal distortion of $5$ against adaptive adversaries, which observe previous winners, and $3$ against oblivious adversaries, which do not. Finally, we generalize the model along two dimensions, the available information and the action space, and establish distortion guarantees for each setting.

papers.title: Proper and Optimal Scoring Rules for Risk-Averse Agents
papers.title_ja: リスク回避的なエージェントに対する適正かつ最適なスコアリングルール
summary_ja: リスク回避的エージェントから信念抽出と情報獲得を促すルールを設計。
エントロピー型リスク選好に対し指数変換による適正スコアリングルールを特定。
2状態モデルでの最適設計や非2状態モデルへの拡張可能性を提示する。
papers.reason_ja: 意思決定理論におけるリスク選好と確率的信念抽出の関係を深掘りしているため。
papers.abstract: Scoring rules are used to elicit probabilistic beliefs through payments that depend on reports and realised outcomes. We ask how these rules should be designed to induce truthful reporting and incentivise costly information acquisition when the agent is risk averse. For agents with entropic risk preferences in finite state spaces, we characterise proper scoring rules through an exponential transformation, derive optimal structures for information acquisition under bounded payments, and obtain explicit optimal coefficients in the binary case. The risk-neutral limit preserves properness and, in the binary case, optimality, while recovering the optimal betting structure for nonbinary states. For optimal design in the binary model, it suffices to focus on rules whose associated concave function is affine on each side of the prior. The optimal coefficients depend only on the prior and the risk-aversion parameter. The binary optimal rules we construct also admit an exact transformation from a particular risk-neutral optimal rule. In the nonbinary model, optimal design reduces to choosing the best prior bound in a transformed betting mechanism.

papers.title: Heterogeneous Risk-Sensitive Evolutionary Learning in Coordination Games: Polarization, Welfare Loss, and Intervention for Efficiency
papers.title_ja: 調整ゲームにおける異種リスク感応型進化学習：極化、福祉損失、および効率的介入
summary_ja: 異なるリスク態度を持つ集団における調整ゲームの進化動学を分析した。
異質性により極化状態が唯一の確率的安定状態となり効率性が低下する。
介入率と強度の双方を十分に高めることで社会的最適を回復できる。
papers.reason_ja: リスク選好の異質性と集団の意思決定・社会的効率性を扱っているため。
papers.abstract: We study evolutionary learning in coordination games in a finite population of agents with heterogeneous risk attitudes, modeled using the entropic risk measure (ERM). The population consists of two subpopulations, each with a fixed risk attitude. Under risk-sensitive best response with mutations (BRM), we characterize the long-run outcomes of the learning process. In particular, we characterize when a polarized state, in which the two subpopulations choose different actions, is uniquely stochastically stable in terms of agents' risk attitudes and the subpopulation sizes. Notably, this polarized state is strictly Pareto dominated by the payoff-dominant equilibrium under both expected payoffs and agents' own ERM-adjusted payoffs. Moreover, its welfare, measured by average expected payoff, is always lower than that of the payoff-dominant equilibrium and can also be lower than that of the risk-dominant equilibrium. Thus, heterogeneity of risk attitudes in learning alone can lead to an inefficient long-run outcome. To mitigate such inefficiency, we propose intervention mechanisms to modify agents' risk attitudes in learning. We show that a sufficiently large intervention share (the fraction of agents modified) and sufficiently high intervention intensity (the increase in their risk parameter) ensure that the payoff-dominant equilibrium is uniquely stochastically stable. However, greater intervention intensity cannot compensate for an insufficient intervention share, and a larger intervention share cannot compensate for insufficient intervention intensity.

papers.title: Matching with Generalized Sequential Choice Rules
papers.title_ja: 拡張された逐次選択ルールを用いたマッチング
summary_ja: 逐次選択ルールを一般化した環境でのマッチング理論に関する研究と推測される。
選択ルールの性質が安定性や実現可能な配分に与える影響を分析したと推測される。
個人の意思決定プロセスの拡張が市場結果に与える影響の解明を意図していると思われる。
papers.reason_ja: 意思決定ルールを拡張したマッチング理論に関心がある研究者に好適なため。

papers.title: What it is to Obey
papers.title_ja: 服従とは何か
summary_ja: ゲーム開始前の情報伝達装置における服従（相関均衡）シグナル条件を分析した。
不完全情報ゲームでは望ましい均衡実現の前提下で直感的シグナルに限定可能と証明。
完全情報ゲームにおいて最良・最悪評価を含む単調評価関数をキャラクタライズした。
papers.reason_ja: 情報構造設計と均衡の服従条件に焦点を当てた意思決定理論の研究であるため。
papers.abstract: Prior to agents taking part in a simultaneous-move game, a designer commits a device that sends signals to each of the agents, evaluating the resulting set of equilibria according to a (Hausdorff-)continuous function. In games of incomplete information I show that it must be without loss of optimality for the designer to restrict attention to direct obedient devices if and only if she assumes her preferred equilibrium will be played. In games of complete information, I characterize the monotone evaluations, which include both the maximally optimistic one and the maximally pessimistic one.

papers.title: A Constant-Factor Single-Sample Prophet Inequality for Subadditive Valuations
papers.title_ja: 劣加法的評価に対する定数因子の単一標本預言者不等式
summary_ja: 単一の標本から単調劣加法的評価をもつ組合せ配分の預言者不等式を構築した。
オフラインアルゴリズムをオンラインでの定数近似保証へ変換する手法を提案した。
任意の到着順序やより強いGoogolゲームモデルに対しても保証が成立することを示した。
papers.reason_ja: 標本に基づくオンライン選択問題やメカニズムデザインに関心のある研究者に適すため。
papers.abstract: We establish a constant-factor single-sample prophet inequality for online combinatorial allocation with monotone subadditive valuations. Given one independent sample from each buyer's unknown distribution, our reduction converts any offline algorithm achieving an $α$ fraction of optimal welfare into an online algorithm achieving an $α/120$ fraction of the expected offline optimum. The guarantee holds for arbitrary arrival orders and extends to the stronger Game of Googol model. Our approach has two key ingredients: a prior-free random score generator and a new sample-based construction of tentative allocations. The tentative allocations capture substantial welfare while controlling contention for items, and the score generator relates itemwise competition in the tentative allocations to the value of retained bundles. The reduction is efficient whenever its offline allocator and score generator are efficient.

papers.title: Optimal Matroid Prophets against Almighty Adversaries and Delegation
papers.title_ja: 全能の敵対者に対する最適マトロイド預言者不等式と委任
summary_ja: 最悪の到着順を決める敵対者に対し最適率1/2を達成する確定的なマトロイド法を証明。
基底集合の分割と各部分への固定閾値適用により確定的な受容判定を実現した。
本手法を応用し相関のあるマトロイド委任問題でも最適係数1/2を達成できると示した。
papers.reason_ja: 動的選択アルゴリズムと代理人への意思決定の委任問題を深掘りしているため。
papers.abstract: We prove an optimal one-half matroid prophet inequality against an almighty ordering adversary: the adversary observes every realized value before choosing the arrival order, whereas the algorithm sees values only as they arrive and must accept irrevocably. The algorithm is deterministic, and its guarantee holds against the stronger ex-ante relaxation. Before any values are revealed, it partitions the ground set, replaces the matroid by a stricter direct sum of minors, and fixes one threshold for each part. It then accepts greedily subject to these fixed tests. The main lemma bounds the expected value of the least valuable basis of the eligible elements. An element contributes either through the rank spanned by eligible elements or through excess value that every eligible basis must retain. This bound holds simultaneously for all bases and therefore permits the arrival order to depend on the entire realization. The same construction gives a deterministic, agent-oblivious mechanism for (possibly correlated) matroid delegation, improving the $1/4$ guarantee to the optimal $1/2$ factor. The principal values are independent, while the strictly positive agent utilities may have arbitrary dependence on the principal values and on one another. The guarantee holds for every best response, including ties resolved against the principal. Both factors are tight already in rank one. For rational finite-support distributions, preprocessing takes polynomial time; each eligible online arrival requires at most one query to the original matroid's independence oracle.

papers.title: The Oracle Is Not Enough: Secure Settlement for Prediction Markets
papers.title_ja: オラクルだけでは不十分：予測市場のための安全な決済
summary_ja: 予測市場の正確な決済に向けクラウドソーシングとステーク投票の階層構造を提示した。
検証コスト下で不正操作を不利益化し経済的安全性を保証するプロトコルを設計した。
実データ評価により99%の市場が少ない報酬支出で安全に決済可能と実証した。
papers.reason_ja: 予測市場を通じた情報集約と制度設計の安全性を論じているため。
papers.abstract: Prediction markets are becoming an important mechanism for aggregating information and forecasting uncertain real-world events. As they grow in scale and value, reliable settlement becomes critical because settlement determines the winning outcome and allocation of market collateral. Yet many heterogeneous markets require market-specific evidence and interpretation, and incorrect settlement can create direct financial incentives for manipulation. In this paper, we ask how to settle heterogeneous markets correctly and efficiently at scale. We first compare existing settlement designs in their support for heterogeneous markets, reliance on direct operator intervention, and resistance to manipulation, motivating a layered architecture that combines incentivized crowdsourcing with stake-backed voting and selective post-settlement review. Building on this architecture, we develop a stake-backed settlement protocol that provides economic security and settlement liveness under market-specific verification costs. Specifically, we prove that manipulation is unprofitable for every settled market and give two constructions that support sufficient self-enforcing participation with controlled reward expenditure. Using historical Polymarket and UMA data, we evaluate the protocol under real-world conditions. We find that 99% of admitted markets can be settled with modest participation rewards even under high verification costs.

papers.title: Coarse Price Discrimination
papers.title_ja: 粗い価格差別
summary_ja: 売り手が提示可能な価格をL個に制限した際の収益損失率を理論的に分析した。
大規模市場下で価格が1つでも最適収益の半分、2つで約73.1%を確保できると証明。
顧客群ごとに個別の価格を提示しなくても高い収益率が得られることを提示した。
papers.reason_ja: 価格設定の制約が意思決定者の収益や市場配分に与える影響を論じるため。
papers.abstract: We study the revenue cost of limiting a seller to $L$ posted prices when heterogeneous buyers with independent values compete for scarce inventory. Our large-market assumption requires that removing any buyer have little effect on optimal revenue. We first make buyers arbitrarily replaceable at each fixed stock and then let stock grow. In this limit, one price guarantees half of optimal mechanism revenue and two guarantee $e/(e+1)$, approximately $73.1\%$. For $L\ge3$, the corresponding guarantee is a $1-1/(2L-1)$ fraction. The guarantees accommodate arbitrary differences in demand across buyers and do not require a separate price for each customer group.

papers.title: Optimal Regret Lower Bounds in Matrix Games
papers.title_ja: 行列ゲームにおける最適リグレット下限
summary_ja: 2人ゼロサム行列ゲームにおける確定的な学習動学のリグレット下限を証明した。
最大個別リグレットがΩ(√(log m log n))となる利得行列の存在を明示。
既存上限と合わせて決定論的学習におけるミニマックスリグレットのタイトな評価を導出した。
papers.reason_ja: 繰り返しゲームにおける対戦者の学習動学と限界に関心を持つ研究者に好適なため。
papers.abstract: We study learning in two-player zero-sum games, also known as matrix games, in which two players with $m$ and $n$ actions repeatedly select mixed strategies for $T$ rounds. The learning dynamics based on optimistic Hedge guarantee regrets of $O(\log(mn))$, which improve to $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ if each player knows the number of actions of the opponent, whereas matching regret lower bounds have been known only for specific learning dynamics. We prove that, for every deterministic learning dynamic, there exists a payoff matrix for which the maximum individual regret is $Ω(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ for a wide range of $m$ and $n$. Together with the upper bound $O(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$, this lower bound shows that the minimax regret of deterministic learning dynamics in matrix games is $Θ(\sqrt{\log m\log n})$ in this regime. For all $m$, $n$, and $T$, we also prove the lower bound $Ω(\min\{T,\log\min\{m,n\}\})$. These lower bounds hold even if each player also observes the strategies and the feedback of the opponent. Our main technical contribution is an adaptive construction of the payoff matrix. While running the algorithms of the two players, we add in each round a rank-one matrix that keeps the feedback of the previous rounds unchanged and increases a lower bound on the sum of the regrets of the two players. As by-products, we obtain lower bounds on the rate at which the average strategies converge to a Nash equilibrium and on the query complexity of matrix-vector products that deterministic algorithms need to compute an approximate Nash equilibrium.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Disclosure and Welfare
papers.title_ja: プライバシー保護情報開示と余剰
summary_ja: 単一の独占販売者が複数の買い手に販売する市場モデルを考察した。
個人の嗜好を一切開示しないプライバシー制約下の厚生を分析した。
制約の有無にかかわらず同一の消費者・生産者余剰が達成可能と示した。
papers.reason_ja: プライバシー制約と厚生の関係をメカニズムデザインで扱う研究に役立ちます。
papers.abstract: We consider a monopolist selling to multiple buyers. A platform observes buyers' tastes and can publicly disclose information about those tastes. However, the platform faces a privacy constraint: the disclosure must reveal nothing about any individual buyer's taste. We show that the same pairs of consumer and producer surplus are attainable with or without this constraint. For each such pair, we construct a privacy-preserving disclosure rule under which a posted-price mechanism attains the pair and no other feasible selling mechanism earns more.

papers.title: Contests versus Contracts in Innovation Procurement
papers.title_ja: イノベーション調達におけるコンテスト対契約
summary_ja: イノベーション調達において導入すべき最適な競争の形態を検討した。
成功と失敗の双方が契約可能な場合、相互依存契約が最適結果を生む。
成功のみ契約可能な場合、期間や技術の異質性で最適なメカニズムが変わる。
papers.reason_ja: 契約理論やコンテスト設計、実験を通じた情報獲得の研究に強い示唆を与えます。
papers.abstract: How much competition should a designer introduce when procuring innovation? We study a designer funding multiple technological approaches whose feasibility is learned through experimentation. Between independent contracts and contests, we introduce interdependent contracts, which combine approach-specific rewards with continuation decisions that depend on rivals' outcomes. When both breakthroughs and breakdowns are contractable, these contracts implement the optimum by extracting firms' rents and coordinating experimentation across approaches. When only breakthroughs are contractable, we compare simple mechanisms with constant contractual payments. Under technological symmetry, optimal interdependent contracts terminate experimentation at a success cutoff or deadline. Fixed-prize contests can implement the same innovation outcomes, but their relative expenditure depends on the experimentation horizon: for interior success cutoffs, contests are more expensive when the horizon is short and less expensive when it is sufficiently long. Rank-contingent contests can weakly outperform constant-payment interdependent contracts, but technological heterogeneity can reverse this ranking because individualized contracts better tailor incentives to different approaches. We further characterize optimal interdependent contracts with time-varying payments, extending the comparison beyond simple mechanisms. Our results show how outcome contractability, technological heterogeneity, and payment flexibility shape the desirable form of competition in innovation procurement.

papers.title: Query-Sample Tradeoffs for Revenue Maximization
papers.title_ja: 収益最大化におけるクエリとサンプルのトレードオフ
summary_ja: 買い手の価値分布が未知の単一買主における収益最大化を分析した。
価値サンプルと価格設定クエリの獲得コストのトレードオフを導出した。
分布の性質によって情報源相互の代替性・補完性が変化することを示した。
papers.reason_ja: 情報獲得と未知環境での最適意思決定を理論的に解明したい研究者に適しています。
papers.abstract: We introduce and study the full query-sample tradeoff for revenue maximization with a single buyer whose value follows an unknown distribution. A learner may adaptively combine value samples, which reveal full buyer values, with pricing queries, which reveal only whether a fresh buyer accepts a selected price. The goal is to learn a price that achieves a $(1-\varepsilon)$-multiplicative approximation to optimal revenue with high probability. We ask when, and by how much, reducing the sample budget increases the number of pricing queries required. We establish tight tradeoff bounds for monotone-hazard-rate (MHR), regular, and quasi-monotone-hazard-rate (quasi-MHR) distributions, and almost tight bounds for quasi-regular distributions. Our results reveal sharply different benefits from combining the two information sources. Quasi-MHR distributions admit a smooth intermediate tradeoff: additional samples can reduce the query requirement by polynomial factors. For MHR and regular distributions, however, a sufficiently small constant fraction of the sample-only requirement still leaves the learner facing the full asymptotic query cost attainable with one sample. Our upper bounds are achieved by algorithms that collect all value samples before making queries, while our lower bounds hold even under arbitrary adaptive interleaving of the two forms of access. Along the way, we also fully characterize the sample-only and single-sample query complexities for all four families, eliminating the extra logarithmic dependence on $1/\varepsilon$ in the literature.

papers.abstract: This paper studies the sale of supplementary training dataset to improve predictive model. The buyer not only has private knowledge of its own dataset, but also can choose the way to merge these two datasets. This flexibility imposes a new constraint on the menu, requiring the buyer's total net utility be monotonic in the Blackwell order on private datasets. Given that, we show that a single posted price for a fully informative dataset is optimal in hypothesis testing, under differential virtual-value condition. The result extends to multi-class classification in which private datasets share a clean component but differ in how their labels are contaminated.

papers.title: Collateral Architecture and Correlated Slashing in Liquid Restaking
papers.title_ja: リキッド・リステーキングにおける担保構造と相関スラッシング
summary_ja: リステーキングにおける担保の再利用と相関リスクを統一モデル化した。

papers.abstract: Liquid restaking protocols allow pooled stake to support multiple slashable commitments, creating an allocation problem in which additional rewards must be balanced against correlated slash claims. This risk depends not only on dependence between slash events, but also on how collateral is allocated or reused across commitments. We develop a unified model ranging from unique stake, where capital is divided among positions, to shared collateral, where the same capital supports multiple commitments. We show that portfolio variance is governed jointly by gross exposure, exposure concentration, and failure dependence. Spreading fixed capital reduces risk toward a correlation-dependent floor, whereas repeatedly pledging the same collateral can make risk grow quadratically with breadth. We then study risk-sensitive allocators competing for fixed reward pools distributed proportionally to committed exposure. A single allocator has a unique optimum, and in a symmetric benchmark greater risk sensitivity encourages diversification under unique stake but discourages additional commitments under shared collateral. With multiple allocators, positive background stake guarantees a unique pure Nash equilibrium and supports a globally convergent projected method. Reproducible synthetic stress tests support these mechanisms. In the strongest common-factor environment, relaxing the reuse cap raises equilibrium reward by 2.47 times but aggregate 99% conditional value at risk by 3.77 times. Competition creates overexposure relative to a planner, while ignoring covariance raises true variance by 6.3%. The results provide a unified framework for collateral reuse, correlated operational risk, and incentive design in decentralized security markets.

papers.title_ja: 社会的学習を伴うボランティアのジレンマ

papers.abstract: We study the interaction of observational learning and free‐riding through a dynamic volunteer's dilemma: If one member of a group performs a costly task, a public good that benefits everyone equally is produced. The value of the public good is uncertain, and each individual receives a private signal about it. The central mechanism is that members make inferences about each other's private signals by observing their actions, while aware of their free‐riding incentives. The main findings concern the probability of public good provision and information aggregation. First, the probability of provision is nonmonotonic with respect to population size: If the population is small, increasing it to a certain threshold leads to an upward jump in the probability of provision. Above this threshold, the probability of provision gradually decreases as population size increases. Second, due to free‐riding incentives, there are no information cascades in equilibrium even when the population is arbitrarily large: Learning becomes slower as population grows, and social learning never outweighs the private signal.

Equitable Growth’s senior fellow for tax and regulatory policy, David S. But people also love the streets of Osaka, Taipei, and Hong Kong. While the buildings of the latter cities are mostly modern and nondescript, their streets are still full of character and enchantment. The Austrian architect Camillo Sitte (pronounced ‘zitter’) sought to explain what makes some public spaces more successful than others in a lively, opinionated masterpiece called The Art of Building Cities , published in 1889 . Sitte argued that the best public spaces are physically enclosed and fairly small, creating a sense of shelter and intimacy, defining picturesque views and perspectives, and making public buildings appear larger and more dignified by comparison. He denied the importance of symmetry and claimed, counterintuitively, that monuments should be pushed to the edge of squares, and that great public buildings should generally be entangled in a mass of everyday housing. Sitte’s book was explosively successful, seizing the imagination of late nineteenth-century Europe. For a few decades, Sitte was a decisive figure in international urban planning, and planners across the world strove to implement his ideas. But after modernism came to dominate Western planning in the mid-twentieth century, Sitte was mostly forgotten. Sitte’s planning theories were hugely influential around the world, though they were quickly eclipsed by the rise of modernist planning. This unrealized plan for Canberra (1911–12), by the Arts and Crafts designer Ernest Gimson, shows strong Sittesque influence. Source: Leicester Museums / Bridgeman Images. Sitte’s attacks were directed against the repetitive grids, sweeping boulevards, and impersonal regularity of most nineteenth-century urban planning . To many people today, however, nineteenth-century urbanism is relatively appealing; certainly, it is a lot more attractive than the motorways, slab blocks, and concrete plazas that came after. This can make Sitte strange to read, but it also makes him even more important now than he was in his own time. Anyone who wants to build beautiful cities today needs to understand what it is that makes the most beloved cities of the past so successful. Focusing only on the appearance of buildings can only get you so far. As Sitte showed, some of the world’s most impressive buildings are badly let down by their surroundings, and form part of inhospitable and uninviting public spaces. Equally, neighborhoods consistent with Sittean principles can be wonderfully charming even if their constituent buildings are nothing special. Understanding these principles may be the key to building new neighbourhoods and cities that people truly love being in. People feel calmer and more protected in such spaces, which they experience as ‘outdoor rooms’. An enclosed outdoor area can also develop its own character, just as kitchens, bedrooms, and bathrooms have their respective characters. ruscn.abstract: На XXI пленарном заседании Государственного Собрания (Ил Тумэн) Якутии принят закон о бюджете территориального фонда ОМС региона на 2027 год и плановый период 2028–2029 годов. «Основные средства направят на территориальную программу ОМС — первичную, скорую, специализированную и высокотехнологичную помощь, диспансеризацию, реабилитацию и ЭКО. Дополнительно профинансируют паллиативную помощь и обеспечение лекарствами и средствами реабилитации детей с тяжелыми заболеваниями. Норматив на диспансеризацию в 2027 году – более пяти млрд рублей при плане 422 тысяч посещений. Численность застрахованных в республике составляет 925 тысяч человек», — сообщили в пресс-службе Ил Тумэна. Доходы фонда на 2027 год запланированы в размере 81 млрд 911,8 млн рублей (рост на 782,9 млн рублей). Расходы на следующий год составят 81 млрд 961,8 млн рублей. Доходы на 2028 год — 86 млрд 945,2 млн рублей, на 2029 год — 92 млрд 108,6 млн рублей.
